crossRefs.note: Behold, he goes by me, and I don’t see him. He passes on also, but I don’t perceive him.
Why do you stand far off, Yahweh? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
Most certainly you are a God who has hidden yourself, God of Israel, the Savior.’ ”
He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen, nor can see: to whom be honor and…

translations.web: “If I go east, he is not there; if west, I can’t find him;
translations.bsb: If I go east, He is not there, and if I go west, I cannot find Him.
translations.kjv: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I cannot perceive
translations.asv: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; And backward, but I cannot perceive him;
